requirements.quote: A "report an error" action on any fetched fact in `apps/web` (with the user's consent to share that record with CauseDeck staff for correction).
Add a per-tracked-case plan kind to the plan catalogue
`apps/admin` Review queue: items from low parse confidence, conflicts and reports, with assignment, SLA, a fix form, and send-to-workbench (#fixture workbench) to create a regression fixture.
metering of tracked cases in packages/billing and core billing entitlements
Fixes to global records propagate to watchers as corrections with provenance ("corrected by CauseDeck review").
A user report reaches the queue and its fix propagates to every watcher of that record. [type:integration]
Each fixed item can become a fixture with one action. [type:integration]
Reviewers see only the record under review; access is logged. [type:unit]

Reliable data needs a human-in-the-loop queue for low-confidence parses, cross-source conflicts (#499) and errors reported by users ("this date is wrong"). Each correction should also improve the parser, as a new fixture.
Acceptance: charge computed from tracked case count with tests.

deliverables.change: New global `review_item` (kind low_confidence|conflict|user_report, source_id, record key cnr+field, shown/corrected value, consent boolean required true for user_report, status open|in_review|fixed|dismissed, assignee, due_at, fixture_exported_at; no workspace id) and tenant `review_correction` via tenantTable (proceeding, field, value, review_item_id, provenance source_type system, source_ref `causedeck-review:<id>`, confirmation_state corrected). Export from packages/db/src/schema/index.ts.

Add optional `perTrackedCase?: boolean` to Plan, export TRACKED_CASE_PRICE_PAISE (integer paise per case per month, ex-GST), and an `active:false` catalogue row id `institution-case-monthly`, kind 'dedicated', interval month, perSeat false, perTrackedCase true, limits PAID. No new PlanKind (no migration).

New migration at the next free timestamp/number (check `ls packages/db/migrations | tail` at implement time; renumber if the base took it) with regenerated snapshot/journal: both tables, RLS for review_correction, SECURITY DEFINER `app_review_propagate(item_id)` guarded by app_staff_require_caller() (pattern 0072/0082) that inserts one review_correction per case_watch with same source_id+cnr, REVOKE PUBLIC, GRANT causedeck_app/causedeck_clerk.
requirements.change: Add pure `trackedCaseChargePaise(plan, trackedCases)`; extend mandateChargeNotice counts with optional `trackedCases` (charge = pricePaise*trackedCases when plan.perTrackedCase); checkPlanConfig: invalid if perSeat and perTrackedCase both set, minimum charge 0 for per-case plans; re-export TRACKED_CASE_PRICE_PAISE.

New `review` domain (queue.ts, propagate.ts): reportError (needs consent), enqueueFromSignal (dedup per source+kind, content-free), list/get (get returns only that item's record and records `staff.read` audit), assign, setSla by kind, resolveWithFix (calls propagate), markFixtureExported. Add `./review` export in packages/core/package.json.
Extend SeatCounts/cycleChargePaise (and quote counts) with optional trackedCases so per-case plans price from the count.
Enqueue low_confidence and conflict review items from the existing parse_yield and conflict_rate detections (source-level, no record content). Keep recordParseRun and alert behaviour unchanged.
Invoice line quantity and description use tracked cases for perTrackedCase plans (input gains optional trackedCases).

Audited staff actions (requireStaff('data-ops'), record staff.read/other event): assign, set status, submit fix (propagates), sendToWorkbench (reuses @causedeck/adapters/workbench buildFixture and returns the bundle in one action, sets fixture_exported_at). Add page.tsx and [id]/page.tsx for the queue (kind, SLA, assignee) and fix form; add nav entry in apps/admin/components/console-nav.tsx and keep apps/admin/lib/roles.ts matrix (ops+admin).

Add `countTrackedCases(db, workspaceId)` (count of portfolio_case rows via the caller's workspace-scoped queryable) and `getTrackedCaseCharge(db, workspaceId, now?)` returning {plan id, trackedCases, chargePaise} from the current subscription's plan (0 for non per-case plans).

Report-error action (use server) with consent checkbox on the fetched next date/stage/bench, and show review_correction rows as 'corrected by CauseDeck review' via apps/web/lib/matters/workspace.ts; i18n strings in packages/i18n/src/messages/{en,kn,ta}/matters.json (+ generated catalog).
Register countTrackedCases and getTrackedCaseCharge in SERVICE_TESTS pointing at the services.test.ts case.
Add `review` to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (audit; matter-graph only if used, through its index.ts) and document it in docs/engineering/core-domains.md; update data-ops entry if it now imports review.
Real two-tenant case: B's count/charge ignore A's portfolio_case rows; A unchanged.

Register review exports (SERVICE_TESTS with real cases in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts, or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason), review_item in GLOBAL_TABLES and review_correction in the RLS catalog/two-tenant seeders (packages/db/src/index.test.ts, packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts); add the web action to ACTIONS in apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts.
Tests: per-case charge from count (0, 1, 1000), config check, catalogue row inactive and frozen, not offered by active list. Also add cases to service.test.ts and on-payment.test.ts for D3/D4.

New tests: report without consent rejected; report reaches queue; fix propagates to every watcher in two workspaces and not to a non-watcher; reviewer get returns only the item's record and writes an audit event; fixture export in one action.
DB test: workspace on institution plan with N portfolio_case rows gets chargePaise = N*price; Junior gets 0.

preserve.what: matter-graph next-date services (proposeNextDate, chooseNextDateSource) and the no-direct-listing-update guard: no new direct writes to listing (packages/core/src/matter-graph/next-date.ts)
Data Ops global tables stay content-free and recordParseRun/alert ledger behaviour (packages/core/src/data-ops/index.ts, packages/db/src/schema/data-ops.ts)
Existing fixture workbench actions and their no-persistence rule for the contributed document (apps/admin/app/(console)/fixtures/actions.ts)
Staff role matrix and tests (apps/admin/lib/roles.ts, apps/admin/__tests__/roles.test.ts); #499 agreement model and app_staff_conflict_rate (packages/core/src/facts, migration 0082)
Existing seat and fixed plan charges: mandateChargeNotice/cycleChargePaise outputs for junior, advocate, chamber unchanged (packages/billing/src/plans.ts, service.ts)
PLAN_KINDS and the plan_kind_chk DB check unchanged; no migration (packages/db/src/schema/billing.ts:53)
GET /v1/billing/plans and the web plan picker list only active plans; the institution plan is not self-serve (apps/api/src/routes/v1/billing.ts:55, billing-view.ts:240)
Plan seed maps catalogue rows to plan table columns only (packages/db/src/seed/plans.ts); perTrackedCase is not a DB column

decisions.choice: Model the 'global record' as source_id + cnr + field and fan fixes out through a staff-guarded SECURITY DEFINER function writing tenant review_correction rows
decisions.justification: Tenant data is FORCE RLS; staff reach it only through definer functions (packages/db/migrations/0072_staff_parse_yield.sql, 0082_staff_conflict_rate.sql:11-35); no global fact table exists for case status (packages/db/src/schema/case-watch.ts:31-110)
decisions.choice: Reuse existing PlanKind 'dedicated' for the per-case plan instead of adding 'institution'
decisions.justification: A new kind needs a plan_kind_chk migration and snapshot (packages/db/src/schema/billing.ts:53), API enum (validators/src/api/billing.ts:9) and fairness map (core/src/usage/fairness.ts:12); 'dedicated' already exists everywhere and no row uses it

decisions.choice: Do not write listing directly for propagated corrections
decisions.justification: next-date.ts header (lines 1-3) makes it the only writer of listing.canonical/list_date, enforced by the no-direct-listing-update architecture test

decisions.choice: Review items store no workspace id and a user_report requires consent=true; low-confidence and conflict items come from source-level Data Ops signals only
decisions.justification: Data Ops tables are global and content-free (packages/db/src/schema/data-ops.ts:1-3); 'with the user's consent to share that record' in the issue

decisions.choice: Provenance text 'corrected by CauseDeck review' carried as source_type system + source_ref causedeck-review:<id> + confirmation_state corrected, no new enum value
decisions.justification: SOURCE_TYPES/CONFIRMATION_STATES at packages/db/src/columns.ts:14-30 already cover it; avoids an enum migration
Institutions are provisioned, not self-served; active plans feed the picker (billing-view.ts:240) and public API (api/routes/v1/billing.ts:55)

decisions.choice: New core exports are registered in SERVICE_TESTS
decisions.justification: CLAUDE.md registry table for runtime exports of @causedeck/core
